optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction
professionalSummary: Seasoned Site Project Coordinator with three years of experience managing utility‑scale solar farm construction sites, consistently maintaining up‑to‑date construction schedules, comprehensive daily site diaries, and accurate permit‑to‑work registers. Proven track record of delivering weekly progress reports to developers, tracking material deliveries, and documenting hand‑over conditions at key milestones. Strong collaboration with subcontractors, health and safety advisers, and developer representatives.
experienceHighlights: Maintained construction schedules weekly for two sites, integrating progress reports from four subcontractors.
Recorded daily site diaries and permit‑to‑work registers, audited quarterly with zero findings.
Prepared weekly progress reports for developer site representatives, filed with comments.
Tracked material deliveries against schedule, resolving supplier queries and escalating to site manager as needed.
Authored hand‑over condition notes at mechanical completion and grid connection milestones, countersigned by site manager.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one month of schedule updates, one week of site diary and permit‑to‑work register pages, one weekly progress report, and one milestone hand‑over note, all referenced in the site folder.

role.roleTitle: Site Project Coordinator, Solar Farm Construction

evidence.text: Site project coordinator on two utility-scale solar farm sites for a construction contractor over three years, keeping the construction schedule current each week with the four subcontractors' reported progress.
Recorded the daily site diary and the permit-to-work register under the site procedures, with both audited quarterly by the site health and safety adviser without findings.
Prepared the weekly progress report for the developer's site representative, with the reports and the representative's comments filed in the site folder.
Tracked the material deliveries against the schedule in the delivery log, recording which delivery queries I resolved with the suppliers and which needed the site project manager's site instruction.
Wrote the hand-over condition notes at the mechanical completion and grid connection milestones on both sites, countersigned by the site project manager.
